technique_name: Explain the concept of Heuristic Evaluation
description: Heuristic evaluation is a process used to identify usability issues with a product or system. It involves human experts reviewing and analyzing the user interface, taking into account various usability criteria. The heuristic evaluation process involves assessing the user interface according to an established set of usability principles, or heuristics.
